3. Engine::Init() → Logger → Profiler → TimerManager → EventLoop → ScriptVM → PhysicsBridge
4. ScriptVM::DoDirectory("resources/script") → 所有 .lua 文件 → 触发 require("net") 等
5. Engine::InitScript() → 调用全局 Lua OnStart()
6. Engine::Run() → Start() (帧定时器+信号) → EventLoop::Run() (阻塞)
7. Shutdown → Cleanup() → 逆序释放 (Physics → Lua → Timer → Profiler → Logger)
→ HrTimer + TimerWheel + AlarmTimer 到期回调
→ 物理命令入队 (no-op when disabled)

libevent 异步事件: TCP/HTTP/UDP/KCP 网络回调在此间分发
